  {"step":2,"file":"src/tools/ftfuzzer/rasterfuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":67,"var":"n_points","code":"short n_points = short( size_ / ( vsize + tsize ) );","note":"The input length determines how many outline points and tags are interpreted from the same byte stream."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src/tools/ftfuzzer/rasterfuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":70,"var":"points","code":"FT_Vector* points = reinterpret_cast<FT_Vector*>( const_cast<uint8_t*>( data ) );","note":"The beginning of the attacker buffer is reinterpreted as the outline point array."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src/tools/ftfuzzer/rasterfuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":73,"var":"tags","code":"char* tags = reinterpret_cast<char*>( const_cast<uint8_t*>( data + size_t( n_points ) * vsize ) );","note":"A later slice of the same attacker buffer is reinterpreted as the outline tag array."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src/tools/ftfuzzer/rasterfuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":91,"var":"outline","code":"FT_Outline outline = { 1, n_points, points, tags, contours, FT_OUTLINE_NONE };","note":"The crafted point/tag arrays are packaged into an FT_Outline object that FreeType will rasterize."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src/base/ftoutln.c","function":"FT_Outline_Get_Bitmap","line":661,"var":"outline","code":"return FT_Outline_Render( library, outline, &params );","note":"The outline is handed to the renderer entry point, which forwards it to the active rasterizer."},
  {"step":7,"file":"src/raster/ftraster.c","function":"ft_black_render","line":3143,"var":"outline","code":"const FT_Outline* outline = (const FT_Outline*)params->source;","note":"The rasterizer receives the attacker-controlled outline through the render parameters."},
  {"step":8,"file":"src/raster/ftraster.c","function":"ft_black_render","line":3160,"var":"outline->n_points / outline->contours","code":"if ( outline->n_points != outline->contours[outline->n_contours - 1] + 1 ) return FT_THROW( Invalid );","note":"The rasterizer validates the contour endpoint relationship before rendering, but the bug is reached after this validation on a malformed yet accepted outline shape."},
  {"step":9,"file":"src/raster/ftraster.c","function":"Render_Glyph","line":null,"var":"raster buffer / outline walk","code":"Render_Glyph( RAS_VAR );","note":"The rasterizer walks the outline and writes scan conversion results into its internal buffers; the vulnerable candidate is the malformed outline that drives an out-of-bounds write in this phase."}
]
open('/workspace/candidate_trace.json','w').write(json.dumps(trace, indent=2))
